title: 第15章跟我谈资格？你也配？

content_zh:
两队禁军立即冲了上去，瞬间就将龙飞给围住。
“我看谁敢！”龙飞冷笑一声，直呼其名道：“龙战武，你还没有资格抓我，你是什么身份，龙家一位长老而已，我是什么身份，我乃是龙家少主未来的神龙侯，想要动我，你配？”
完全不把龙战武放在眼里。
龙战武眉心一狞，双拳紧握，无形的怒气释放出来，沉沉道：“龙飞，你无视家规，打伤禁军，残忍杀害龙家家仆，现在连龙大耀都被你杀了，你罪恶滔天，龙家任何一人都能定你得罪。”
“跟我谈资格？”
“你也配？”
龙傲得意笑道，“龙飞，你就乖乖跪下认罪吧，哈哈哈……”
龙飞不急不忙的说道：“龙战武，我问你，侮辱龙家少主，未来的神龙侯，是什么罪？”
龙战武脸色一凛。
龙飞再说道：“禁军阻拦龙家少主，出手攻击少主，这又是什么罪？”
龙战武的脸色又是一沉。
龙飞再问道：“身为龙家奴仆，却陷害少主，抓我的贴身丫鬟，酷刑相逼，我再问你，这又是什么罪？”
山洞口，忽然静了下来。
被龙飞三局质问，龙战武竟回答不上来。
执法堂的龙战野也是微微震住，看着龙飞，感觉已经不在是以前的龙飞了，换了个人似得。
这才是龙家少主应有的霸气和狂妄，才是神龙侯府的继承人。
龙战武不罢休，道：“其它的都可以不追究，但是龙大耀乃是龙家弟子，纵然你是少主也没有权利杀他……”
龙家弟子只有龙家执法堂才能执法。
这点龙飞也是知道的。
不等龙战武说完，龙飞笑道：“你看到我杀龙大耀吗？如果没看到，就请你闭嘴！明白？”

龙战武的表情有些狰狞起来。
他在发怒。
在狂怒，可是……他却找不到地方发泄出来。
龙飞的变化他也能感觉到，再则龙飞的确是少主身份，侮辱少主都是重罪，罪可当杀。
他不甘愿就这样放掉龙飞，不想就这样错过这个大好机会。
龙傲在一边说道：“爹，别跟他讲那么多，先把他杀了再说。”
龙战武眉心一狞。
杀了龙飞自然不难，可是……他要的是民心，龙家的民心，如果没有给出合理的理由杀掉龙飞的话，哪怕龙飞是个废物，他也会被人诟病，会影响他登上家主之位，何况，龙家并不是表面上那么简单。
如果一步没有走好，他会万劫不复。
龙战野上前问道：“刚才洞中的确传出龙大耀的求救声，他到现在还没有出来，应该是死了吧？”
龙飞反问道：“请问龙大耀什么修为？”
龙傲抢先一步道：“这个我知道，龙总管八级战师巅峰境界。”
龙飞说道：“那请问，我和他比起来谁更强？他被我杀掉？你们觉得可能吗？”
这样一问。
龙战野也沉默了下来。
一个小境界的差距都无法逾越，更不要说丹田破碎，筋脉郁结，龙血被抽离的龙飞，那就更加不是对手了。
可刚才所有人都听的很清楚。
龙飞笑道：“执法堂既然不相信，大可以派人进去查看，看看里面是否有龙大耀的尸体。”
不等龙战野说话，龙傲上前一步，道：“我去查看。”
走到龙飞身边，龙傲得意的说道：“龙飞，等我找到龙总管的尸体，你就准备受死吧。”

“啪！”
话音刚落。
龙飞反手就是一耳光扇了下去，“竟然敢威胁少主，找打！”
龙傲直接被扇趴下，脸颊红肿，痛的咧嘴大叫，“爹，他打我。”
“呼……”龙战武重重的吸了一口气，双目微微一眯，沉沉的说道：“进去搜！”
当着龙战武的面打他儿子。
龙战野对龙飞的认识又深了一步，心中暗道：“就算是天才时期的龙飞也不敢这样，想不到半年时间变化这么大，而且……他的修为变强了。”
龙傲握着脸颊，带着几名侍卫冲进山洞。
半个小时后。
龙傲垂头丧气的走出来，低声道：“没有找到龙总管的尸体，没有任何的痕迹。”
这个时候。
龙飞玩味十足的笑道：“战武伯伯，污蔑少主，这可是重罪，看在你是长辈的份上我就不与你计较，下次可别犯这样的错哦。”
抱着乔乔，柔声说道：“我们回家。”
扬长而去，完全没有看龙战武他们一眼。
直到走下后山确定龙战武他们没有跟来，龙飞才长长的呼出一口气，后背冷汗已经湿透，“刚才还真是危险，龙战武身上的战王气息太浓烈了，我竟然承受不住。”

content_en:
The two groups of forbidden troops immediately rushed forward and surrounded Long Fei in an instant.
"Let's see who dares!" Long Fei sneered and called him by his name: "Long Zhanwu, you are not qualified to arrest me. What is your identity? You are just an elder of the Long family. What is my identity? I am the future Shenlong Marquis of the young master of the Long family. If you want to touch me, are you worthy?"
He didn't take Long Zhanwu seriously at all.
Long Zhanwu frowned, clenched his fists, and released his invisible anger. He said solemnly: "Long Fei, you ignored the family rules, injured the imperial guards, and brutally killed the Long family's servants. Now you have even killed Long Dayao. Your crimes are so heinous that anyone in the Long family can convict you."
"Discuss qualifications with me?"
"Are you worthy?"
Long Ao smiled proudly and said, "Long Fei, just kneel down and plead guilty, hahaha..."
Long Fei said calmly: "Long Zhanwu, let me ask you, what is your crime for insulting the young master of the Long family, the future Shenlong Marquis?"
Long Zhanwu's face turned pale.
Long Fei said again: "The imperial army blocked the young master of the Long family and attacked the young master. What kind of crime is this?"
Long Zhanwu's face darkened again.
Long Fei asked again: "As a slave of the Long family, I framed the young master, captured my personal maid, and tortured her. I ask you again, what is this crime?"
At the entrance of the cave, it suddenly became quiet.
After being questioned by Long Fei for three rounds, Long Zhanwu couldn't answer.
Long Zhanye from the Law Enforcement Hall was also slightly shocked. Looking at Long Fei, he felt that he was no longer the same Long Fei as before, as if he was a different person.
This is the domineering and arrogance that the young master of the Long family should have, and he is the heir to the Shenlong Hou Mansion.
Long Zhanwu didn't give up and said: "You can ignore everything else, but Long Dayao is a disciple of the Long family. Even if you are the young master, you have no right to kill him..."
Only the Long Family Law Enforcement Hall can enforce the law for Long family disciples.
Long Fei also knew this.
Before Long Zhanwu could finish speaking, Long Fei said with a smile: "Did you see me killing Long Dayao? If not, please shut up! Do you understand?"
Long Zhanwu's expression became a little ferocious.
He is angry.
He was furious, but...he couldn't find a place to vent it.
He could also feel the changes in Long Fei. Furthermore, Long Fei was indeed the young master. Insulting the young master was a serious crime punishable by death.
He was unwilling to let Long Fei go like this, and he didn't want to miss this great opportunity.
Long Ao said on the side: "Dad, don't talk to him so much, kill him first."
Long Zhanwu frowned.
It is naturally not difficult to kill Long Fei, but... what he wants is the people's support, the people's support of the Long family. If he does not give a reasonable reason to kill Long Fei, even if Long Fei is a waste, he will be criticized by others, which will affect his ability to ascend to the position of head of the family. Moreover, the Long family is not as simple as it seems.
If he doesn't make the right move, he will be doomed.
Long Zhanye stepped forward and asked, "Long Dayao's cry for help was indeed heard from the cave just now. He hasn't come out yet. He must be dead, right?"
Long Fei asked back: "Excuse me, what is Long Dayao's cultivation level?"
Long Ao took the lead and said, "I know this. Chief Long is at the peak level of an eighth-level combat master."
Long Fei said: "Then, who is stronger between me and him? Was he killed by me? Do you think it is possible?"
Ask like this.
Long Zhanye also fell silent.
Even a small realm gap is insurmountable, let alone Long Fei, whose Dantian is broken, his veins are stagnated, and his dragon blood has been drained, so he is even less of a match.
But everyone heard it clearly just now.
Long Fei smiled and said: "Since the Law Enforcement Hall doesn't believe it, you can send someone in to check to see if there is Long Dayao's body inside."
Before Long Zhanye could speak, Long Ao took a step forward and said, "I'll go check."
Walking to Long Fei's side, Long Ao said proudly: "Long Fei, when I find the body of Manager Long, prepare to die."
"Crack!"
The words just fell.
Long Fei slapped him with his backhand, "How dare you threaten the young master?Looking for a fight! "
Long Ao was slapped down and his cheeks were red and swollen. He grinned in pain and shouted, "Dad, he hit me. "
"Huh..." Long Zhanwu took a deep breath, narrowed his eyes slightly, and said solemnly: "Go in and search! "
Beat his son in front of Long Zhanwu.
Long Zhanye's understanding of Long Fei deepened, and he thought to himself: "Even Long Fei in the genius period would not dare to do this. I didn't expect that he had changed so much in half a year, and... his cultivation had become stronger. "
Long Ao held his cheek and rushed into the cave with several guards.
Half an hour later.
Long Ao walked out dejectedly and whispered: "The body of Manager Long was not found, and there were no traces. "
This time.
Long Fei smiled playfully and said: "Battle with Uncle Wu and slander the young master. This is a serious crime. Since you are an elder, I won't argue with you. Don't make such a mistake next time. "
Holding Qiaoqiao in his arms, he said softly: "Let's go home. "
He walked away without even looking at Long Zhanwu and the others.
It wasn't until he walked down the back mountain to make sure that Long Zhanwu and the others were not following him that Long Fei let out a long breath, his back already soaked with cold sweat, "It was really dangerous just now. The aura of the King of War on Long Zhanwu was so strong that I couldn't bear it. "
